study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Tong et al., Journal of Affective Disorders, 2024
study_identification_part.si4_title: Individual deviations from normative electroencephalographic connectivity predict antidepressant response

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Develop an EEG connectivity-based normative modeling framework to quantify individual deviations from healthy norms and test whether these deviations predict antidepressant treatment response (sertraline and placebo) in MDD.

rci1_dataset_name.reason: Methods and Supplementary clearly state three independent HC cohorts used to build the healthy norm.
rci1_dataset_name.supporting_text: We built a normative model with ... EEG connectivity data from healthy controls of three independent cohorts. ... 8 subjects from the EMBARC cohort, 75 from Depression-EEG, and 71 from LEMON.

rci2_hc_n.supporting_text: ... we developed healthy norms of 154 young adults (age 18-25), which consist of 8 subjects from the EMBARC cohort, 75 subjects from the depression-EEG cohort, and 71 subjects from the LEMON cohort.

rci8_quality_checking.detail: Automated pipeline: resample to 250 Hz; remove 60 Hz; 0.01 Hz high-pass; epoch and channel rejection; exclude subjects with >20% bad channels; spherical spline interpolation; ICA to remove muscle/ocular/ECG artifacts; common average reference; band-filter to theta/alpha/beta/gamma. EMBARC MDD exclusions: 21 missing baseline EEG, 13 low data quality, 32 no endpoint, yielding n=221.
rci8_quality_checking.supporting_text: The recorded rsEEG data were cleaned offline with a fully automated artifact rejection pipeline ... (1)-(10) ... Subjects lacking endpoint HAMD17 were excluded ... 21 ... 13 ... 32 ...

rci9_site_effect_handling.detail: ComBat harmonization by cohort (batch = EMBARC/Depression-EEG/LEMON) with age as covariate; train transform on healthy controls and apply to patients; performed separately for EO/EC x frequency bands.

caa6_deviation_metric.answer: Per-connection reconstruction error: individual deviation = raw FC − reconstructed FC from autoencoder; continuous deviations used as features (no fixed threshold).
caa6_deviation_metric.reason: Methods define deviation as reconstruction error for each FC.
caa6_deviation_metric.supporting_text: ... the difference between the original EEG FC and the reconstructed one, termed reconstruction error, was utilized as the quantification of individual deviation ...

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Two-stage pipeline: (1) Connectome-based predictive modeling (feature selection by Pearson correlation with HAMD17 change within training folds; P<0.05) and (2) LASSO regression with inner 10-fold CV to predict HAMD17 change. Performance evaluated via 10-fold CV repeated 10×; significance by two-sided tests; Fisher's z tests for method comparisons.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Individual deviations from normative rsEEG connectivity significantly predict antidepressant responses (sertraline r=0.43; placebo r=0.33), outperforming raw FC and alternative deviation strategies, with site-generalizable and arm-specific signatures.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: EO-gamma deviations predicted sertraline response (n=102, r=0.43, R²=0.15, pFDR=4.74×10^-5). EO-alpha also significant (r=0.33, pFDR=0.0076). Placebo response: best model r=0.33 (from main text), with condition-specific performance detailed in Supplementary Table 8. Sertraline model did not predict placebo (r=0.03, p=0.74) and vice versa, indicating specificity. Leave-study-site-out showed sertraline predictability on held-out sites (r=0.30, p=0.0022). Autoencoder-based deviations outperformed raw FC and PCA-/regression-based deviations (e.g., sertraline: raw FC r=0.17; PCA r=0.15; regression r=0.20).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Harmonization with ComBat (batch=cohort, age covariate); source-space PEC connectivity (Brainstorm/OpenMEEG/FreeSurfer); 100-ROI Schaefer atlas; eight EEG conditions (EO/EC × theta/alpha/beta/gamma); CPM for feature selection; LASSO regression; leave-study-site-out validation; clinical interpretation by correlating deviations vs reconstructed FC with CTQ/QIDS/MASQ measures.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Not explicitly detailed in the provided text. Potential limitations include reliance on harmonization across heterogeneous cohorts and lack of external clinical dataset validation beyond EMBARC.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: Autoencoder architecture: input/output 4950 features (ROI-ROI FC), hidden layer 500; sigmoid activations; L2 constraint. Norms built using young adults (18–25) to match demographics across HC cohorts. Trial registration: EMBARC NCT#01407094.
